title: Microsoft Teams: more messages on screen in the iOS and Android apps

claims.claim: Messaging policies in the Teams admin center control which chat and channel messaging features users get.
claims.quote: Messaging policies are used to control which chat and channel messaging features are available to users (owners and members) in Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy exists in the MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module and updates Teams messaging policies.
claims.quote:
Module:
    - MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module

This cmdlet updates a Teams messaging policy.

claims.claim: Teams messaging policies include an Immersive reader for messages setting.
claims.quote: Immersive reader for messages - Turn this setting ON to let users view messages in Microsoft Immersive Reader.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy can control whether users can use Immersive Reader for messages.
claims.quote:
-AllowImmersiveReader

Determines whether a user is allowed to use Immersive Reader for reading conversation messages. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this FALSE to prohibit.
